ios.desc:
Potatso is a Mihomo (Clash) compatible network proxy tool for iPhone and iPad. Import your servers or subscriptions, choose how your traffic is routed, and keep an eye on your connections.

== Multiple Proxy Protocols ==
Manage servers using Shadowsocks, ShadowsocksR, HTTP(S), SOCKS5 (including TLS), VLESS (including Reality), VMess, Trojan, Hysteria2, AnyTLS, and Snell.

== Imports and Subscriptions ==
Import through links, files, or QR codes, or add servers manually. Bring in supported servers, policy groups, rules, and DNS settings from Clash/Mihomo, V2Ray/Xray, and Surge configurations. Check the import preview for compatibility details.
Keep subscriptions and remote resources up to date with automatic updates, while retaining your local changes to subscribed configurations.

== Flexible Routing ==
Switch between Rule, Global, and Direct modes. Select nodes manually or let policy groups choose automatically. Add custom rules, install community rule sets, and manage GeoIP/GeoSite data to route traffic to suit your setup.

== Live Connection Details ==
See upload and download speeds, traffic charts, and active connections, including their matched rules and proxy chains.

== Custom DNS ==
Configure DNS servers and domain-based resolution policies, with support for DNS over HTTPS and DNS over TLS.

== Widgets and Quick Controls ==
Check connection status, control your connection, and switch between available nodes from Home Screen widgets. On iOS 18 and later, use the Control Center connection toggle.

== Potatso Pro ==
Pro lets you create multiple profiles, run node latency tests, and remove ads. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Prices are shown in the app.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and renewal is charged within 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.

== Before You Connect ==
Potatso does not provide proxy servers. Use your own servers or an existing proxy subscription.
